text.tspan: JASPER DRIVE (450 North extension · major collector · built with Phase 1)
DELTA CROSSINGS — SOUTH PARCEL · CONCEPT C: TOWNHOME
Townhome buildings on both new tiers for maximum unit count. Delta City R-4 · land south of Jasper Drive, west of the commercial line.
Concept only — not for construction · generated 2026-10-20
Harvest Lane south of Jasper (dedicated Ph. 1)
Tier depths north / south of Street A
Open space: Parcel A / new OS-1 / Parcel C
Zoning — Parcel is inside the 49.055-ac M-H to R-4 rezone
Allowed uses — R-4 allows SF, two-, three-, four-family and townhomes; max 4 units/building
Townhome building lot area — 7,500 SF + 2,000 SF per unit after the first
Tightest building lot 704 SF over minimum [DCC 18.24.040; 18.64.190.3a]
Lot frontage — 70' minimum, 75' corner; townhomes measured across the building
Setbacks — Front 25', side 10', rear 10', corner street side 20'
Every footprint inside its setback envelope [DCC 18.24.040]
Parking — 3 side-by-side 9x18 stalls per unit; no tandem; garage or driveway, not both
3 driveway stalls per unit; garages not counted [DCC 18.64.050 (Ord. 2022-299)]
Townhome parking — Stalls on the unit's own lot, fronting the ROW, not shared
27' driveway (3 stalls) on every unit lot [DCC 18.64.190.4]
Townhome open space — 500 SF private open space per unit on its own lot
Townhome frontage and walks — Every building fronts a public street; 4' walk from each unit to the ROW
Each unit lot touches the ROW; own 4' walk [DCC 18.64.190.7]
One principal structure per lot — Each building on its own lot; units on their own unit lots
One building per lot; townhome units on unit lots [DCC 18.64.010.A]
Street section — 60' ROW; 41' asphalt, 2.5' curb and gutter, 5' walks both sides
Street A/B: 60' ROW, ST-02 section [DCC 16.24.050; ST-02 (Ord. 2025-317)]
Street pattern — No alleys, cul-de-sacs or permanent dead ends
Street A/B loops Harvest Lane to Jasper Drive [DCC 16.24.060 / 16.24.070]
Lot access — Every lot abuts a 60' public street; side lines square to the street
All lots front Harvest Lane or Street A [DCC 16.24.120.B, D]
Jasper Drive frontage — No driveways on Jasper (450 North major collector); 10' rear planting buffer
North-tier lots back onto Jasper with a 10' rear buffer; needs LUA approval as double-frontage lots [DCC 16.24.090; TMP 2025 §7]
Intersections — Streets meet at 90° and line up with existing intersections
Street A leaves Harvest at 90°; Street B lines up with Emerald Way (4-way) [TMP 2025 §7.5 (Ord. 2025-318)]
Storm drainage — Hold the 24-hour, 10-year storm on site (NOAA Atlas 14: 1.37 in)
11,488 CF (0.26 ac-ft) extra storage; about 3.8 in. over the basin [DCC 16.28.030.I]
Ditches — No open ditches within or adjoining the subdivision
Pipe the Parcel C ditch if it is live (about 225 LF) [DCC 16.28.030.H; 18.64.040]
Utility easements — 15' total easement width; 10' PUE along lot fronts
10' front PUE inside the 25' setback; 7.5' rear/side easements as needed [DCC 16.24.080; Phase 1 plat]
Parcel A — Platted as open space / retention for Phase 1
Kept as the retention basin [Phase 1 plat; Utah Code 10-9a-608]
New townhome building lot (dashed = unit lots)
Lots 116-118 and Harvest Lane (Phase 1 plat) are carried here
and removed from the main proforma.
Street B lines up with Emerald Way, so no new access point on Jasper.
Townhome units are 31' wide: 27' three-stall driveway + 4' walk.
Double-frontage lots on Jasper need LUA approval (16.24.090).
Parcel A: plat lists 49,782 SF; its calls close at 53,880 SF.
Verify whether the Parcel C ditch is live before final design.
